subject: math

objective.text: Estimate weights using benchmarks: 1 kilogram, 100 grams, 10 grams and 1 gram. Read spring scales.

explanations.title: Benchmark weights
explanations.text: Hold a 1 kilogram weight in one hand. Hold an object in the other. Is it less than, more than, or about the same?

explanations.title: Read the interval first
explanations.text: Find what one interval on the scale is worth. Then count intervals to the arrow.

explanations.title: Grams or kilograms
explanations.text: Light things like a postcard are measured in grams. Heavy things like a cat are measured in kilograms.

source_ref.section: Problem Set, Side 2 (circle the correct unit)

explanations.title: 1 kilogram is always 1 kilogram
explanations.text: 1 kilogram of bricks and 1 kilogram of feathers weigh the same. Both are 1 kilogram.

examples.title: A scale labelled by 200
examples.text: Count 200, 400, up to 2,000. This scale measures up to 2,000 grams. Each small mark is 20 grams.

examples.title: 5 intervals make 500 grams
examples.text: 5 intervals show 500 grams, so 1 interval is 100 grams. Count 100, 200, up to 1 kilogram.

questions.text: Skip-count by sevens. 63 is how many sevens?

source_ref.section: Fluency: Group Counting (63 is how many sevens?)

questions.text: 1 kilogram is 900 grams and how many more grams?
1 kilogram is 350 grams and how many more grams?
Justin puts a 1 kilogram bag of flour on a pan balance. How many 100 gram bags balance it?
Each interval on this scale is 1 kilogram. The arrow points at the third mark. How much do the apples weigh?
On a scale, 5 intervals show 500 grams. How much is 1 interval?
A scale is labelled 200, 400, 600, and so on, up to the last label. It has 10 labels. How many grams can it measure?

source_ref.section: Concept Development, Part 1 (spring scale by two-hundreds)

questions.text: Each tick mark is 20 grams. How many tick marks from 0 to 100 grams?
A box of cereal weighs about 350. Grams or kilograms?
A watermelon weighs about 3. Grams or kilograms?
A postcard weighs about 6. Grams or kilograms?
A bicycle weighs about 15. Grams or kilograms?
Derrick's water bottle weighs 1 kilogram. The laptop weighs the same as 2 bottles. How much does the laptop weigh?
Nessa says 1 kilogram of rice weighs the same as 10 bags of 100 grams of beans. Do you agree? Why?
Alicia weighs a cell phone. The scale shows 113, but the unit is missing. Grams or kilograms? How do you know?
Which weighs more: 1 kilogram of bricks or 1 kilogram of feathers?

Every visual must be checked by a person: the count shown must equal the stimulus in the question and the rubric answer key.
